description.en: High-frequency synonyms and antonyms for Assam competitive exams.
description.as: অসমৰ প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাৰ বাবে সঘনাই সোধা সমাৰ্থক আৰু বিপৰীত শব্দ।

a.en: 'Retain' means to keep something; it is the opposite of 'abandon' (to give up).
a.as: 'Retain' মানে ৰাখি থোৱা; এইটো 'Abandon' (পৰিত্যাগ কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Detest' means to hate someone or something very much.
a.as: 'Detest' মানে কাকোবা কোনো বস্তুক অতি ঘৃণা কৰা।

a.en: 'Establish' means to set up permanently; it is the opposite of 'abolish' (to do away with).
a.as: 'Establish' মানে স্থাপন কৰা; এইটো 'Abolish' (উচ্ছেদ কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Sensible' means reasonable and practical; it is the opposite of 'absurd'.
'Discord' means disagreement and conflict; it is the opposite of 'accord'.
a.as: 'Discord' মানে মতভেদ আৰু সংঘাত; এইটো 'Accord' (মতৈক্য) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Cling' means to stick firmly to something, like 'adhere'.
'Prosperity' means success and good fortune; it is the opposite of 'adversity'.
a.as: 'Prosperity' মানে সমৃদ্ধি আৰু সৌভাগ্য; এইটো 'Adversity' (দুৰ্ভাগ্য) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Clumsy' means awkward in movement; it is the opposite of 'agile'.
a.as: 'Clumsy' মানে গতিৰ ক্ষেত্ৰত থেৰেগেৰা; এইটো 'Agile' (চপল) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Native' means belonging to one's own place; it is the opposite of 'alien'.
a.as: 'Native' মানে নিজ ঠাইৰ; এইটো 'Alien' (বিদেশী) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Unclear' means open to more than one interpretation, like 'ambiguous'.
a.as: 'Unclear' মানে অস্পষ্ট বা একাধিক অৰ্থ দিব পৰা; 'Ambiguous'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Insufficient' means not enough; it is the opposite of 'ample'.
a.as: 'Insufficient' মানে অৰ্যাপ্ত নহয়; এইটো 'Ample' (পৰ্যাপ্ত) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Modern' means of the present time; it is the opposite of 'ancient'.
'Indifference' means lack of interest, like 'apathy'.
'Hidden' means not seen or not obvious; it is the opposite of 'apparent'.
a.as: 'Hidden' মানে লুকুৱাই থোৱা; এইটো 'Apparent' (স্পষ্ট) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Difficult' means needing much effort, like 'arduous'.
a.as: 'Difficult' মানে অধিক পৰিশ্রমৰ প্ৰয়োজন হোৱা; 'Arduous'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Moist' means slightly wet; it is the opposite of 'arid' (very dry).
a.as: 'Moist' মানে কিছু আৰ্দ্র; এইটো 'Arid' (অতি শুকান) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Natural' means produced by nature; it is the opposite of 'artificial'.
'Bold' means brave and daring, like 'audacious'.
'Fake' means not genuine; it is the opposite of 'authentic'.
a.as: 'Fake' মানে ভুৱা বা নকল; এইটো 'Authentic' (প্ৰকৃত) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Greed' means an intense desire for wealth, like 'avarice'.
a.as: 'Greed' মানে ধন-সম্পত্তিৰ প্ৰতি তীব্র লোভ; 'Avarice'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Graceful' means elegant and smooth; it is the opposite of 'awkward'.
a.as: 'Graceful' মানে সাৱলীল আৰু সুন্দৰ; এইটো 'Awkward' (থেৰেগেৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Civilized' means polite and advanced; it is the opposite of 'barbarous'.
a.as: 'Civilized' মানে সভ্য আৰু উন্নত; এইটো 'Barbarous' (বর্বৰ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Fertile' means able to produce crops; it is the opposite of 'barren'.
a.as: 'Fertile' মানে উৰ্বৰ বা শস্য উৎপাদনক্ষম; এইটো 'Barren' (অনুৰ্বৰ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Kind' means gentle and helpful, like 'benevolent'.
'Clarify' means to make clear; it is the opposite of 'bewilder'.
a.as: 'Clarify' মানে স্পষ্ট কৰা; এইটো 'Bewilder' (বিভ্রান্ত কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Flagrant' means openly and obviously wrong, like 'blatant'.
'Sharp' means having a fine cutting edge; it is the opposite of 'blunt'.
'Noisy' means making a lot of noise, like 'boisterous'.
'Timid' means shy and fearful; it is the opposite of 'bold'.
a.as: 'Timid' মানে ভয়াতুৰ আৰু লাজুক; এইটো 'Bold' (সাহসী) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Slow' means not fast; it is the opposite of 'brisk'.
'Gentle' means kind and mild; it is the opposite of 'brutal'.
a.as: 'Gentle' মানে কোমল আৰু দয়ালু; এইটো 'Brutal' (নিষ্ঠুর) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Disaster' means a sudden great misfortune, like 'calamity'.
a.as: 'Disaster' মানে হঠাৎ ঘটে যোৱা ডাঙৰ দুর্ঘটনা বা বিপর্যয়; 'Calamity'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Frankness' means openness and honesty, like 'candor'.
'Frank' means open and honest in speech, like 'candid'.
a.as: 'Frank' মানে খোলাখুলি আৰু সৎ কথা কোৱা; 'Candid'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Fascinate' means to attract and hold attention, like 'captivate'.
a.as: 'Fascinate' মানে আকর্ষিত আৰু মন্ত্রমুগ্ধ কৰা; 'Captivate'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Reckless' means careless about danger; it is the opposite of 'cautious'.
a.as: 'Reckless' মানে বিপদৰ প্রতি ভ্রূক্ষেপ নকৰা; এইটো 'Cautious' (সতর্ক) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Begin' means to start; it is the opposite of 'cease' (to stop).
a.as: 'Begin' মানে আৰম্ভ কৰা; এইটো 'Cease' (বন্ধ হোৱা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Slowness' means lack of speed; it is the opposite of 'celerity'.
'Smooth' means even and not rough; it is the opposite of 'coarse'.
'Cruelty' means causing pain to others; it is the opposite of 'compassion'.
a.as: 'Cruelty' মানে আনক কষ্ট দিয়া; এইটো 'Compassion' (সহানুভূতি) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Simple' means easy to understand; it is the opposite of 'complex'.
'Understand' means to grasp the meaning, like 'comprehend'.
'Hide' means to keep out of sight, like 'conceal'.
'Praise' means to express approval; it is the opposite of 'condemn'.
a.as: 'Praise' মানে প্রশংসা কৰা; এইটো 'Condemn' (নিন্দা কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Deny' means to refuse to admit; it is the opposite of 'confess'.
a.as: 'Deny' মানে অস্বীকাৰ কৰা; এইটো 'Confess' (স্বীকাৰ কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Surrender' means to give up; it is the opposite of 'conquer'.
a.as: 'Surrender' মানে আত্মসমর্পণ কৰা; এইটো 'Conquer' (জয় কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Changeable' means likely to change; it is the opposite of 'constant'.
'Honest' means truthful and upright; it is the opposite of 'corrupt'.
a.as: 'Honest' মানে সৎ আৰু ন্যায়পৰায়ণ; এইটো 'Corrupt' (দুর্নীতিপৰায়ণ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Rude' means impolite; it is the opposite of 'courteous'.
'Incredible' means hard to believe; it is the opposite of 'credible'.
a.as: 'Incredible' মানে বিশ্বাস কৰা কঠিন; এইটো 'Credible' (বিশ্বাসযোগ্য) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Straight' means not bent or curved; it is the opposite of 'crooked'.
a.as: 'Straight' মানে বেঁকা নোহোৱা; এইটো 'Crooked' (বেঁকা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Cowardly' means lacking courage; it is the opposite of 'daring'.
'Honesty' means truthfulness; it is the opposite of 'deceit'.
'Conceal' means to hide; it is the opposite of 'declare' (to announce).
a.as: 'Conceal' মানে লুকুৱাই ৰখা; এইটো 'Declare' (ঘোষণা কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Rebellious' means resisting authority, like 'defiant'.
'Sparse' means thinly scattered; it is the opposite of 'dense'.
a.as: 'Sparse' মানে ঠায়ে ঠায়ে থকা; এইটো 'Dense' (ঘন) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Grant' means to give; it is the opposite of 'deprive'.
a.as: 'Grant' মানে দিয়া বা প্ৰদান কৰা; এইটো 'Deprive' (বঞ্চিত কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Hope' means a feeling of expectation; it is the opposite of 'despair'.
'Admire' means to respect and look up to; it is the opposite of 'despise'.
a.as: 'Admire' মানে শ্রদ্ধা আৰু প্রশংসা কৰা; এইটো 'Despise' (তাচ্ছিল্য) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Lazy' means unwilling to work; it is the opposite of 'diligent'.
a.as: 'Lazy' মানে কামত অমান্তি; এইটো 'Diligent' (পৰিশ্রমী) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Increase' means to become larger; it is the opposite of 'diminish'.
a.as: 'Increase' মানে বৃদ্ধি হোৱা; এইটো 'Diminish' (হ্রাস হোৱা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Conceal' means to keep secret; it is the opposite of 'disclose'.
a.as: 'Conceal' মানে গোপন ৰখা; এইটো 'Disclose' (প্রকাশ কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Harmony' means agreement and peace; it is the opposite of 'discord'.
a.as: 'Harmony' মানে শান্তি আৰু ঐক্য; এইটো 'Discord' (মনোমালিন্য) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Cheerful' means happy and bright; it is the opposite of 'dismal'.
'Interesting' means holding attention; it is the opposite of 'dull'.
'Fragile' means easily broken; it is the opposite of 'durable'.
a.as: 'Fragile' মানে সহজে ভাগি যোৱা; এইটো 'Durable' (স্থায়ী) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Reluctant' means unwilling; it is the opposite of 'eager'.
'Frivolous' means not serious; it is the opposite of 'earnest'.
a.as: 'Frivolous' মানে গম্ভীৰ নোহোৱা; এইটো 'Earnest' (গহীন) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Normal' means usual and conventional; it is the opposite of 'eccentric'.
a.as: 'Normal' মানে সাধাৰণ আৰু প্রচলিত; এইটো 'Eccentric' (অদ্ভুত) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Depressed' means sad and low in spirits; it is the opposite of 'elated'.
a.as: 'Depressed' মানে বিষণ্ণ; এইটো 'Elated' (আনন্দত উৎফুল্ল) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Graceful' means having elegance and beauty of movement, like 'elegant'.
'Lower' means to move down; it is the opposite of 'elevate'.
a.as: 'Lower' মানে তললৈ নামোৱা; এইটো 'Elevate' (ওপৰলৈ তোলা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Fluent' means able to speak smoothly and clearly, like 'eloquent'.
'Discharge' means to send out or give off, like 'emit'.
'Tiny' means very small; it is the opposite of 'enormous'.
a.as: 'Tiny' মানে অতি সৰু; এইটো 'Enormous' (বিশাল) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Friendship' means a friendly relation; it is the opposite of 'enmity'.
'Tangle' means to twist together into a mess, like 'entangle'.
a.as: 'Tangle' মানে জঠিল বা জট লগোৱা; 'Entangle'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Jealousy' means resentment of another's success, like 'envy'.
'Permanent' means lasting forever; it is the opposite of 'ephemeral'.
'Hidden' means not easily seen; it is the opposite of 'evident'.
a.as: 'Hidden' মানে লুকুৱাই থকা; এইটো 'Evident' (সুস্পষ্ট) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Humiliate' means to lower in dignity; it is the opposite of 'exalt'.
a.as: 'Humiliate' মানে অপমান কৰা; এইটো 'Exalt' (প্রশংসা বা উচ্চীকৃত) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Frugal' means careful in spending; it is the opposite of 'extravagant'.
'Invent' means to create or make up, like 'fabricate'.
a.as: 'Invent' মানে উদ্ভাৱন কৰা বা ৰচনা কৰা; 'Fabricate'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Strong' means having great power; it is the opposite of 'feeble'.
'Gentle' means mild and kind; it is the opposite of 'ferocious'.
a.as: 'Gentle' মানে কোমল আৰু শান্ত; এইটো 'Ferocious' (হিংস্র) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Barren' means unable to produce crops; it is the opposite of 'fertile'.
'Steady' means firm and unchanging; it is the opposite of 'fickle'.
a.as: 'Steady' মানে স্থিৰ; এইটো 'Fickle' (চপল বা পৰিৱর্তনশীল) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Flexible' means able to bend or change; it is the opposite of 'firm'.
'Stay' means to remain in one place; it is the opposite of 'flee'.
a.as: 'Stay' মানে থাকি যোৱা; এইটো 'Flee' (পলাই যোৱা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Wisdom' means good judgement; it is the opposite of 'folly'.
'Strong' means not easily broken; it is the opposite of 'fragile'.
a.as: 'Strong' মানে সহজে নাভগা; এইটো 'Fragile' (ভংগুৰ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Extravagant' means spending too much; it is the opposite of 'frugal'.
'Miserly' means unwilling to give; it is the opposite of 'generous'.
'Authentic' means real and original, like 'genuine'.
'Cheerful' means bright and happy; it is the opposite of 'gloomy'.
a.as: 'Cheerful' মানে উজ্জ্বল আৰু আনন্দময়; এইটো 'Gloomy' (বিষণ্ণ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Beautiful' means very pleasing to look at, like 'gorgeous'.
'Pleasant' means giving pleasure; it is the opposite of 'grim'.
'Cunning' means craftiness and deceit, like 'guile'.
'Gentle' means soft and kind; it is the opposite of 'harsh'.
a.as: 'Gentle' মানে কোমল আৰু মৃদু; এইটো 'Harsh' (কঠোৰ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Deliberate' means done slowly and carefully; it is the opposite of 'hasty'.
a.as: 'Deliberate' মানে সচেতনভাৱে আৰু ধীরে কৰা; এইটো 'Hasty' (খরখেদীয়া) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Humble' means modest, not proud; it is the opposite of 'haughty'.
'Clear' means easy to see through; it is the opposite of 'hazy'.
'Help' means to assist; it is the opposite of 'hinder'.
a.as: 'Help' মানে সহায় কৰা; এইটো 'Hinder' (বাধা দিয়া) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Tiny' means extremely small; it is the opposite of 'huge'.
a.as: 'Tiny' মানে অতি সৰু; এইটো 'Huge' (বিশাল) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Proud' means having too high an opinion of oneself; it is the opposite of 'humble'.
'Active' means busy and working; it is the opposite of 'idle'.
'Darken' means to make dark; it is the opposite of 'illumine'.
a.as: 'Darken' মানে আন্ধাৰ কৰা; এইটো 'Illumine' (পোহৰ দিয়া) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Mimic' means to copy someone's actions, like 'imitate'.
'Colossal' means extremely large, like 'immense'.
'Biased' means showing favour to one side; it is the opposite of 'impartial'.
'Impulsive' means acting suddenly without thought, like 'impetuous'.
a.as: 'Impulsive' মানে নাভাৱি তৎক্ষণাৎ কাম কৰা; 'Impetuous'ৰ দৰেই।

a.en: 'Active' means energetic and working; it is the opposite of 'indolent'.
'Active' means moving and lively; it is the opposite of 'inert'.
a.as: 'Active' মানে চলমান আৰু সক্ৰিয়; এইটো 'Inert' (নিষ্ক্রিয়) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Guileless' means free from deceit, like 'innocent'.
'Complicated' means having many parts, like 'intricate'.
'Cheerful' means happy and friendly, like 'jovial'.
'Mess' means a disordered mixture, like 'jumble'.
'Mourn' means to feel deep sorrow, like 'lament'.
'Energetic' means full of energy; it is the opposite of 'lethargic'.
a.as: 'Energetic' মানে শক্তিমান আৰু উদ্যমী; এইটো 'Lethargic' (নিস্তেজ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Clear' means easy to understand, like 'lucid'.
'Tempt' means to attract or entice, like 'lure'.
'Splendid' means impressively beautiful, like 'magnificent'.
'Goodwill' means friendly feeling; it is the opposite of 'malice'.
'Ample' means more than enough; it is the opposite of 'meager'.
'Arrogant' means overbearingly proud; it is the opposite of 'meek'.
'Ruthless' means without pity; it is the opposite of 'merciful'.
'Wretched' means extremely unhappy, like 'miserable'.
'Generous' means giving freely; it is the opposite of 'miserly'.
'Conceited' means excessively proud of oneself; it is the opposite of 'modest'.
'Immortal' means living forever; it is the opposite of 'mortal'.
'Gullible' means easily deceived, like 'naive'.
'Stiff' means not flexible in movement; it is the opposite of 'nimble'.
a.as: 'Stiff' মানে টান বা জড়; এইটো 'Nimble' (চপল) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Infamous' means well known for a bad reason, like 'notorious'.
'Countless' means too many to count, like 'numerous'.
'Disobedient' means refusing to obey; it is the opposite of 'obedient'.
'Clear' means easy to see or understand; it is the opposite of 'obscure'.
'Modern' means current and up to date; it is the opposite of 'obsolete'.
'Yielding' means ready to give in; it is the opposite of 'obstinate'.
'Transparent' means allowing light to pass through; it is the opposite of 'opaque'.
'Pessimistic' means expecting the worst; it is the opposite of 'optimistic'.
'Plain' means simple without decoration; it is the opposite of 'ornate'.
'Indignation' means strong anger at injustice, like 'outrage'.
'Provoke' means to stir up anger; it is the opposite of 'pacify'.
a.as: 'Provoke' মানে উত্তেজিত কৰা; এইটো 'Pacify' (শান্ত কৰা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Significant' means important; it is the opposite of 'paltry'.
'Strange' means unusual and odd, like 'peculiar'.
'Danger' means risk of harm, like 'peril'.
'Everlasting' means never ending, like 'perpetual'.
'Devout' means deeply religious, like 'pious'.
'Calm' means peaceful and undisturbed, like 'placid'.
'Scarce' means insufficient in quantity; it is the opposite of 'plentiful'.
'Loot' means to steal goods by force, like 'plunder'.
'Exact' means accurate in every detail, like 'precise'.
'Economical' means avoiding waste; it is the opposite of 'prodigal'.
'Copious' means abundant in quantity, like 'profuse'.
'Punctual' means on time, like 'prompt'.
'Affluent' means rich and successful, like 'prosperous'.
'Humble' means having a modest opinion of oneself; it is the opposite of 'proud'.
'Discreet' means careful and sensible, like 'prudent'.
'Suppress' means to put down or stop, like 'quell'.
'Extinguish' means to put out a fire or satisfy thirst, like 'quench'.
'Fast' means quick in movement, like 'rapid'.
'Cautious' means careful to avoid danger; it is the opposite of 'rash'.
'Obedient' means willing to obey; it is the opposite of 'rebellious'.
'Careful' means taking precautions; it is the opposite of 'reckless'.
'Accept' means to agree with something; it is the opposite of 'refute'.
a.as: 'Accept' মানে গ্ৰহণ কৰা; এইটো 'Refute' (খণ্ডন) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Repulse' means to drive back or refuse, like 'repel'.
'Attractive' means pleasing; it is the opposite of 'repulsive'.
'Determined' means firm in purpose, like 'resolute'.
'Curb' means to hold back or control, like 'restrain'.
'Talkative' means fond of speaking a lot; it is the opposite of 'reticent'.
a.as: 'Talkative' মানে বাচাল; এইটো 'Reticent' (কম কথা কোৱা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Flexible' means able to change or bend easily; it is the opposite of 'rigid'.
'Strict' means demanding and thorough, like 'rigorous'.
'Competitor' means one who competes, like 'rival'.
'Sturdy' means strong and healthy, like 'robust'.
'Merciful' means showing kindness and forgiveness; it is the opposite of 'ruthless'.
'Wise' means having good judgement, like 'sagacious'.
'Wild' means fierce and untamed, like 'savage'.
'Plentiful' means available in large amounts; it is the opposite of 'scarce'.
'Contempt' means a feeling of disrespect, like 'scorn'.
'Astute' means clever in judgement, like 'shrewd'.
'Hypocritical' means pretending to be what one is not; it is the opposite of 'sincere'.
'Gullible' means too ready to believe; it is the opposite of 'skeptical'.
a.as: 'Gullible' মানে সহজে বিশ্বাসী; এইটো 'Skeptical' (সন্দেহপ্রবণ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Lethargic' means slow and lacking energy, like 'sluggish'.
'Dense' means closely packed together; it is the opposite of 'sparse'.
a.as: 'Dense' মানে ঘন; এইটো 'Sparse' (ঠায়ে ঠায়ে থকা) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Lenient' means merciful and not strict; it is the opposite of 'stern'.
a.as: 'Lenient' মানে ঢিলা বা সহনশীল; এইটো 'Stern' (কঠোৰ) ৰ বিপৰীত।

a.en: 'Headstrong' means obstinately self-willed, like 'stubborn'.
'Following' means coming after something, like 'subsequent'.
'Trick' means a deceitful device, like 'subterfuge'.
'Concise' means brief and to the point, like 'succinct'.
'Sulky' means silent and bad-tempered, like 'sullen'.
'Deep' means thorough and profound; it is the opposite of 'superficial'.
'Speedy' means moving quickly, like 'swift'.
'Monotonous' means dull and repetitive, like 'tedious'.
'Bold' means brave and confident; it is the opposite of 'timid'.
'Peaceful' means calm and quiet, like 'tranquil'.
'Opaque' means not allowing light to pass through; it is the opposite of 'transparent'.
'Enormous' means very large in size or amount, like 'tremendous'.
'Important' means of great significance; it is the opposite of 'trivial'.
'Stormy' means violent and disturbed, like 'turbulent'.
'Divided' means not in agreement; it is the opposite of 'unanimous'.
'Definite' means clear and precise; it is the opposite of 'vague'.
'Extensive' means covering a large area, like 'vast'.
'Intense' means showing strong feeling, like 'vehement'.
'Respected' means held in high regard, like 'venerable'.
'Careless' means not paying attention; it is the opposite of 'vigilant'.
'Energetic' means full of strength and activity, like 'vigorous'.
'Wicked' means morally bad; it is the opposite of 'virtuous'.
'Lively' means bright and full of life, like 'vivid'.
'Heedless' means careless and inattentive; it is the opposite of 'wary'.
'Thrifty' means careful with money; it is the opposite of 'wasteful'.
'Poor' means having little money; it is the opposite of 'wealthy'.
'Indifferent' means having no interest; it is the opposite of 'zealous'.
